We need to indicate number of C=O groups in the molecule. We have IR spectrum data: wavenumbers list includes 1592, 1580, 1515, 1504 etc. No obvious carbonyl stretch (~1700 cm-1). The list does not include ~1700. So likely zero carbonyl groups.

But we should be careful: maybe the IR data truncated? The list includes only up to 1515. No carbonyl. So answer 0.

We could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). But IR already suggests none. To be safe, maybe check carbon NMR. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool.
